derivation: probably akin to G5420 (φράσσω) through the idea of defining;
def: to indicate (by word or act), i.e. (specially), to expound

occurrences.text: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
